import mir_eval.multipitch
import numpy as np

midi_frequencies = [
    np.array([69.0]),  # A4 -> chroma 9.0
    np.array([]),      # Silence
    np.array([57.0, 76.5]),  # A3 -> chroma 9.0, E5 + 50 cents -> chroma 4.5
]

actual_chroma = mir_eval.multipitch.midi_to_chroma(midi_frequencies)

assert len(actual_chroma) == len(midi_frequencies), "Output list length must match input list length"
assert np.allclose(actual_chroma[0], [9.0]), "69.0 should wrap to 9.0"
assert actual_chroma[1].size == 0, "Empty array should remain empty"
assert np.allclose(actual_chroma[2], [9.0, 4.5]), "57.0 and 76.5 should wrap to 9.0 and 4.5"

print(f"__CHECK__ midi_to_chroma {actual_chroma[0][0]}")
